tagline: Convert times across timezones and plan global meetings in seconds
pageDescription: Convert any time between timezones and plan meetings across the world with this free online Timezone Converter. Choose a date, time and source zone, then add as many cities as you like to see the exact equivalent time everywhere at once — daylight saving is handled automatically. It runs entirely in your browser with no signup, making it ideal for scheduling remote calls, coordinating distributed teams, planning travel and avoiding the classic 'what time is it there?' mistake.

instructions.title: How to convert between timezones

steps.title: Set the date and time
steps.description: Enter the moment you want to convert, or click Now to use the current time. This is the wall-clock time in your source zone.

steps.title: Pick the source timezone
steps.description: Choose the zone the time is in. It defaults to your own timezone, detected from your browser.

steps.title: Add target timezones
steps.description: Use the Add timezone menu to add every city or zone you care about. Add as many as you need for a meeting.

steps.title: Read the converted times
steps.description: Each zone shows the equivalent date, time, weekday and UTC offset, recalculated instantly as you change anything.

steps.title: Find an overlap
steps.description: Scan the times to find a slot that works for everyone, then remove zones you no longer need with the × button.

troubleshooting: Time looks off by an hour: that's daylight saving — verify the date
Wrong source zone: it defaults to your browser zone, change it if needed
A city is missing: pick the closest zone with the same offset and DST rules
Date jumped a day: large offsets push times into the next/previous day, which is correct
Nothing updates: make sure a date and time are entered
